== Features.Numbers (line 113)
| Numbers(n)
  for style=COUNTER
    | for i := 0 to n - 1
    -
      alternative
        | i > 100?
        -
          jump
            | yield break
        -
      instruction
        | yield return i

== Features.Filters (line 144)
| Filters(r)

    | exception

      instruction

        | Exception

    -
